title: Module 39 — Computer Vision
description: See how a machine sees, on a plain CPU with numpy + pillow: build a synthetic image as an (H×W×C) tensor, slide an edge-detecting Sobel kernel across it BY HAND and watch the edges appear, apply blur/sharpen kernels, max-pool to downsample, and threshold to a binary mask (toy segmentation). No GPU, no downloads.
